researchNotes: Official tomfordbeauty.com Shopify feeds (products.json and the Signature and Private Blend collection feeds) were read; the feeds were truncated, so coverage is partial (54 main EDP/EDT/Parfum entries). Notes come from official product pages, which list only "Key Notes" with no top/heart/base split (flat). Pages give no percentage, so concentration is the form named on the page or product title. Perfumer only where a page names one; release year and family are not stated on the pages read. Collection is taken from the official collection feeds. Sets, body sprays, candles, decanter/format duplicates, skincare and makeup were skipped. Brand country not stated on the pages read.

fragrances.name: Ombré Leather Eau De Parfum

sources.name: Tom Ford Beauty - Ombré Leather Eau De Parfum
Jadof — Tom Ford Ombre Leather review (search result text)
Parfumo — Ombre Leather 2018 EDP reviews (search result text only, page not opened)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Jadof estimates 8-10 h on skin (about 12 h on clothing); one Parfumo reviewer reports almost 11 h with everyday sillage. Most common view: longevity 4, sillage 3 (moderate to strong). Parfum, Reserve and Eau d Ombre flankers not used.

fragrances.name: Oud Wood

sources.name: Scento — Tom Ford Oud Wood review 2026 (search result text)
Scentgrail — Tom Ford Oud Wood review (search result text)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scento: soft projection, 4-8 h longevity; Scentgrail: low projection and moderate longevity; Fragman and one Parfumo reviewer: 4-6 h, moderate to weak sillage. Most common view: longevity 3, sillage 2. The Parfum concentration (reported longer-lasting) is not covered by this entry.

fragrances.name: Tobacco Vanille

sources.name: Scento — Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille review 2026 (search result text)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scento guide: about 8-16 h on skin, strong sillage, and cold weather recommended; a Parfumo reviewer reports about 10 h on skin. Most common view: longevity 4 (typical 8-10 h), sillage 4. Dissent: one reviewer finds it faint the next day. Seasons from Scento recommendation for cold weather; no times stated.

sources.name: EveryFumed — Tom Ford Lost Cherry (search result text)
